items.markingKey: 4 marks: Lord Ripon (1882); Government of India Act 1919; Gandhi's gram swaraj; Directive Principle (Art 40); Community Development Programme (1952); Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) – three-tier system; weaknesses – state control, irregular elections, few funds.
